mapper.select: SELECT id , user_email AS userEmail , notification_type AS notificationType , title , content , target_id AS targetId , target_type AS targetType , is_read AS isRead , created_at AS createdAt , read_at AS readAt FROM user_notification WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreadCount FROM user_notification WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND is_read = 0

SELECT v.user_email AS userEmail , v.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , v.visit_date AS visitDate FROM place_visit_history v INNER JOIN user_notification_setting s ON s.user_email = v.user_email AND s.review_reminder_enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN place_review r ON r.user_email = v.user_email AND r.place_id = v.place_id LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id WHERE r.id IS NULL AND v.visit_date <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_notification n WHERE n.user_email = v.user_email AND n.notification_type = 'REVIEW_REMINDER' AND n.target_id = v.place_id AND n.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) )
